exposure: Women with Fabry disease with moderate pain before pregnancy
cohort: 44 women with Fabry disease in Austria
finding: Women with Fabry disease experienced an increase in pain burden during pregnancy and had a significantly increased risk for preeclampsia, prematurity, and neonates small for gestational age compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Delivery by C-section was reported in 24.6% of pregnancies in women with Fabry disease.
birth_weight: 13 (20.3%) children presented with low birth weight
